title: Semantic presentation continuity

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.

allowedWork: Presentation-group contracts, pure continuity laws, focused distribution and radical adapters, tests, stable visual tooling, proposal and Theseus evidence.
disallowedWork: New curriculum, semantic algebra changes, KaTeX changes, Three.js, renderer replacement, unrelated roadmap/thread/design changes, or broad visual redesign before exemplar promotion.
goal: Replace timing-only completion with renderer-neutral presentation-group settlement, repair distribution first, then repair power-to-radical, and promote only after human checkpoints.
commitCadence: Commit after every verified slice; stop for human acceptance after slices 20 and 27.
stopConditions: H1 PRESERVATION: stop on unexplained semantic, identity, correspondence, lineage, seek, rewind, native endpoint, typography, accessibility, route, or review drift.
H2 OWNERSHIP: stop if a renderer-neutral presentation group must own DOM, KaTeX, SVG, canvas, or WebGL resource state.
H3 EVIDENCE: stop if actual rendered output cannot be measured deterministically or opacity can conceal geometry mismatch.
H4 USER OVERLAP: stop before touching overlapping user-owned changes.
H5 SCOPE: stop if the fix requires disallowed work or architectural replacement.
H6 DISTRIBUTION CHECKPOINT: stop after slice 20 for human review before radical work.
H7 RADICAL CHECKPOINT: stop after slice 27 for human review before promotion.

slices.summary: Choreography groups can now declare cohesion lock, settlement anchor, and native owner; validation enforces group-local anchors. Seven hierarchy tests and full typecheck pass.

slices.title: Add native-local member offsets and adjacent-edge geometry snapshots.
slices.summary: Geometry snapshots now retain anchor-local member rectangles and true adjacent edge gaps, including uneven-width and baseline-offset fixtures; four focused tests pass.

slices.title: Define rendered-ink observation for DOM, canvas, and composite owners.
slices.summary: Added pure reducers for measured DOM ink, alpha-grid canvas/WebGL ink, and composite owner unions; transparent padding is excluded. Six tests and full typecheck pass.

slices.title: Add the intra-owner relative-geometry law.
slices.summary: The intra-owner law now reports member position, size, and adjacent-gap residuals against native geometry; the reported late product gap fails while exact native geometry passes. Seven tests pass.
